Every page carries the identical chrome with fixed domIds (nc-nav-home/study/review, nc-rail-home/chat/study/heart, nc-avatar) registered as hideEdge global navigation, plus home-calm nc-cta-continue -> page-study as a content shortcut. sharedProjectShellContract.activeStyleRow: group 1 — airy companion shell (pages/home-calm.html is the shell authority). group 0 (pages/home.html) is the retired dense dashboard variant kept only for comparison and must not be used as a shell source.
sharedProjectShellContract.chrome: 44px macOS titlebar (3 neutral dots + NekoPapa wordmark | centred pill nav 小屋/学习/复习 on a 1fr auto 1fr axis | 37-day streak + avatar link to settings) + 56px icon rail (house / message-circle-more / book-open / heart) + one fluid content stage. No third data rail.
sharedProjectShellContract.navContract: chrome markup is copied verbatim across all group 1 pages; only data-active moves. domIds are fixed: nc-nav-home, nc-nav-study, nc-nav-review, nc-rail-home, nc-rail-chat, nc-rail-study, nc-rail-heart, nc-avatar. Active state uses --apple-secondary surface + foreground/icon-900 only — never the primary hue, never a left indicator bar.
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryHue: single Apple brand blue (--apple-primary). Budget: exactly one primary filled pill CTA per page. Everything else neutral.
sharedProjectShellContract.typeStack: DM Sans (--font-sans) for UI and her lines, JetBrains Mono (--font-mono) + tabular-nums for every numeral
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusModel: --apple-radius-md for icon tiles, --radius / --apple-radius-lg for the one allowed media surface, 999px reserved for pill buttons, pills, avatars and the composer
sharedProjectShellContract.depthModel: card containers are forbidden by default. Hierarchy comes from whitespace and type scale. Static surfaces use hairline borders only; shadows cap at --shadow-sm, --shadow-2xs for the composer.
sharedProjectShellContract.densityBudget: visible info elements <= 10 per first screen, whitespace >= 50%, stage padding 88px vertical / 96px horizontal on desktop
sharedProjectShellContract.herPresence: assets/hero-neko.png appears on every group 1 page as a right-bleed or corner companion layer with a same-hue opacity fade; only the framing/scale changes per page, never replaced by an icon or color block
sharedProjectShellContract.motion: 150ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) token-step feedback; at most one micro-animation per page; prefers-reduced-motion guard required

visualQualityCheckpoints.checkpoint: First screen reads as a desktop application window, not a marketing landing page: 44px native chrome, left rail, center stage, right data rail all visible at 1440x900.
The Live2D character is the single visual anchor of the page; the real hero-neko.png asset carries the stage and no area of the stage is a colored placeholder.
Accent scarcity holds: one blue primary CTA, everything else neutral; streak/XP numerals are mono and tabular.
Gamification trio is legible at a glance: daily goal ring (Duolingo), 7-day streak strip (Duolingo), review queue with mastery bars (Quizlet), her mood meters (Finch).
Composer bar sits at the bottom of the stage with reserved space, never overlapping stage content.

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Pinguo/Apple library: restrained, premium, content-first. Primary accent Pinguo Blue #007aff used only for the single primary action and true selected states. Space Black #0a0a0a and Silver Mist #f5f5f7 neutrals carry the shell. Radius is soft (1.2rem) but buttons are full pill. Whitespace carries hierarchy more than separators or colour blocks. Shadows are whisper-light (start at 1px borders, 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04) at rest, deeper only for hover/overlay). Typography DM Sans 14-16px/400/1.55 body, display 72-96px/600/-0.04em reserved for marketing heroes only; this desktop app uses 11-28px UI scale. JetBrains Mono for numeric/spec moments. Motion cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) at 150/250/350ms. Voice is editorial, precise, calm; no emoji, no conversational filler.

componentIndexSummary.summary: Capsule-shaped actions with a restrained Apple-inspired hierarchy.
Quiet containers defined by border and spacing, not by decoration.
Simple rounded inputs with readable placeholder contrast and visible focus.
Apple-store-like top navigation and restrained secondary rails.

Structured model comparison (not used on this page).

row2ArtDirection.brief: User rejected group 1 as too plain / generic-clean Apple utility. Group 2 keeps the Apple token system (colours, DM Sans, radius, whisper shadows) but changes the COMPOSITION and PHYSICALITY to the reference products' mechanics: Duolingo = tactile press-depth controls, HUD of streak/gems/hearts, a winding unit path, chunky progress rings; Finch = the character's inner state is the product (mood/energy/knowing-you meters that visibly change the room, gentle daily ritual, she goes out and brings back things); Quizlet = real study mechanics (3D card flip, mastery heatmap, timed drill with keyboard A-D, score report).
row2ArtDirection.shellContract: 44px titlebar with 3 neutral dots + wordmark + centred pill nav (小屋/路径/卡堆/羁绊, domIds hud-nav-hut/path/cards/her) + right HUD cluster (streak flame 37 / gems 240 / hearts 3 / 同伴 LV.6). No left icon rail in group 2 — the stage owns the full width so the character can be large.
row2ArtDirection.physicality: Primary actions get a 4px solid bottom edge in a darker brand step (--brand-600) and translate 1px down on :active (press depth). Rings/bars are 8-12px thick with rounded caps, not 2px hairlines. Numerals are big (28-44px) mono tabular.
row2ArtDirection.colorBudget: One hue family (Apple blue scale 50-600) + state-success + chart-3 amber + state-error, used ONLY for game state (streak, gems, hearts, mastery, correct/wrong). UI chrome stays neutral. No purple/pink gradients, no rainbow.
row2ArtDirection.characterPresence: hero-neko.png must be large and load-bearing on every group 2 page (min 38% of stage area), never a small corner thumbnail or a placeholder block.
row2ArtDirection.antiPlain: Each page needs one unforgettable moment: hut = her room with living meters + she-naps-until-you-return; path = the winding unit road with locked nodes and a league; cards = a real 3D flip with combo counter and mastery heatmap; her = the bond level ring + what she brought back from outside.
